items.title: AZO Q3 CY2026 Deep Dive: Commercial Growth and Store Expansion Drive Results Amid DIY Softness
items.summary: Auto parts and accessories retailer AutoZone (NYSE:AZO) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2026, but sales rose 5.6% year on year to $6.59 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $56.05 per share was 4.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: AutoZone Inc (AZO) (Q4 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Record Store Growth and $20 Billion ...
items.summary: AutoZone Inc (AZO) topped $20 billion in annual sales for the first time, opened a record 374 stores, and posted 15.1% Q4 EPS growth, though soft DIY demand and LIFO charges tempered the outlook.
